_comment: Shapes AND field numbers of every message interpret.rs parses. Both rotate between client builds -- the 2026-08-04 update moved a number in every message here except crush_slot. Edit this file and restart; no rebuild. Loaded from the working directory, so run the sniffer from sniffer/. Definitions whose name starts with _ are notes.
_build: 2026-08-04, re-identified end to end against known in-game actions. testdata/schema-2026-07-10.json is the previous build, kept so its captured fixtures still run.
_kinds: varint | packed (length-delimited run of varints) | f32 (4 little-endian bytes) | message (needs `of`). `repeated: true` keeps every copy; without it the last wins, as protobuf does.
_rederive: Dump the message with --all and read the tags against something checkable: an item whose DofusDB template you have, or a price visible in the HDV. RUNBOOK part 2 step 5.

stat_line._note: One rolled line. Value comes before effect id on the wire, which reads backwards.

item_entry._note: One item instance. Quantity is absent for a single copy, which is how equipment always arrives; the adapter reads that as 1.

slot._note: The envelope every entry-carrying message wraps an item_entry in.

item_detail._note: The server describing one instance, usually answering a crush_slot_put.

inventory._note: The whole bag as a snapshot, not a delta. Identified by uid: the item just bought appears in this listing and in no other container listing.

inventory_add._note: One stack arriving. Same envelope as item_detail on this build, at a different number.

inventory_quantity._note: A stack resized. The quantity is the NEW size, not a delta.

inventory_remove._note: One instance has left the bag: crushed, sold or dropped.

crush_slot._note: Item into the breaker. Delta is SIGNED: -1 is taking one back out, and both directions are answered by an identical item_detail, so the sign is the only thing telling them apart.

crush_body._note: Field 5 is a second f32 equal to field 4 in every sample seen; purpose unknown, so it is not read.

crush_result._note: The item TYPE is not here. It arrives as an item_detail under the same uid, which main.rs caches.

price_offer._note: A resource quotes one offer whose ladder is a real x1/x10/x100/x1000. Equipment quotes one offer PER COPY on sale, each a single asking price in the x1 slot plus the stats that copy rolled.

price_list._note: A ladder entry of 0 means that batch size is not on sale. Only some offers repeat the item id inline; the outer copy fills the rest.
